{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.16

|arg= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Get an object's water intake ratio when immersed.

|s1= [[getWaterLeakiness]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]] - object to check

|r1= [[Number]] in range 0..1 - 0 is waterproof and 1 is full leak

|x1= <sqf>
if (getWaterLeakiness _myCar > 0) then
{
	hint "don't go in the water with it!";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[setWaterLeakiness]] [[setWaterFillPercentage]] [[getWaterFillPercentage]]
}}
